name: AI-powered causal financial modeling platform for SMBs

mentions.name: AI-powered causal financial modeling platform for SMBs
mentions.description: This platform aggregates a business's operational and financial data and builds a causal model on top, deriving target metrics such as free cash flow or EBITDA. It supports scenario forecasting (e.g., opening a new shop, raising prices, taking a loan) and generates reports including weekly overviews, anomaly detection, and deviations from targets. An AI agent customizes the platform for each specific business and integrates its data sources.
mentions.problem: Large companies have dedicated teams and sophisticated tooling for financial planning and forecasting, while small and medium businesses lack comparable affordable solutions.
mentions.audience: Small and medium businesses, with e-commerce as the primary target
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a platform that aggregates a business's operational and financial data and builds a causal model on top, deriving target metrics like FCF or EBITDA. With that model we can forecast different scenarios — what happens if we open a new shop, raise prices, take a loan.
mentions.author: soontimes
